directions: Directions: In this section you will hear conversations and talks. Each will be followed by questions. Choose the best answer to each question.

script.t: Did you finish the chemistry lab report?
I barely started. The procedure section is taking forever.

items.question: What does the man imply about the lab report?
items.explanation: Pria itu berkata ia baru mulai (I barely started) dan bagian prosedurnya memakan waktu sangat lama (taking forever), artinya ia menganggap laporan itu sulit dan menyita waktu. Pilihan A salah karena ia belum selesai. Pilihan C salah karena tidak ada instruksi yang hilang. Pilihan D salah karena ia tidak berniat membolos.

script.t: The library closes at nine tonight, right?
Actually, it's open until midnight during finals week.

items.question: What does the woman tell the man?
options: The man should study at home.
The library hours are extended this week.
The library is closed for finals.
items.explanation: Wanita itu mengoreksi pria tersebut: perpustakaan buka sampai tengah malam selama minggu ujian (finals week), jadi jam bukanya diperpanjang. Pilihan A salah karena jam sembilan adalah jam tutup menurut dugaan pria itu, bukan jam buka. Pilihan B tidak disebutkan. Pilihan D salah karena perpustakaan justru buka lebih lama.

script.t: How was the physics midterm?
Honestly, it was a piece of cake compared to the quizzes.

items.question: What does the man mean?
items.explanation: Ungkapan a piece of cake artinya sangat mudah. Pria itu menganggap ujian tengah semester fisika mudah, apalagi dibanding kuis-kuis sebelumnya. Pilihan A salah karena ia tidak gagal. Pilihan C salah karena tidak ada perayaan. Pilihan D salah karena kue di sini hanya kiasan.

script.t: My printer ran out of ink right before I printed my essay.
You can use mine. It's in my dorm room, and the door's open.

items.question: What does the woman offer to do?
options: Buy new ink for the man.
items.explanation: Wanita itu berkata You can use mine (kamu boleh pakai punyaku) dan pintunya terbuka, artinya ia menawarkan pinjam printernya. Pilihan A salah karena ia tidak menawarkan membeli tinta. Pilihan B salah karena ia tidak menawarkan mencetakkan. Pilihan D salah karena tidak ada tawaran mengedit.

script.t: Professor Lane moved the deadline to Friday.
That's a relief. I thought it was due tomorrow.

items.question: What does the man imply?
options: He needs more time to finish.
items.explanation: Pria itu merasa lega (That's a relief) karena mengira tenggatnya besok, artinya ia butuh tambahan waktu untuk menyelesaikan tugas. Pilihan B salah karena ia belum selesai. Pilihan C salah karena ia tidak mengeluhkan dosennya. Pilihan D salah karena ia ingat tugas itu.

script.t: You look a little pale. Are you okay?
I'm just a bit under the weather, but I'll be fine for the game.

items.question: What does the woman mean?
options: She is worried about the weather.
She is angry at the man.
items.explanation: Ungkapan under the weather artinya agak tidak enak badan atau sakit ringan. Wanita itu merasa sedikit sakit tetapi tetap akan ikut pertandingan. Pilihan B salah karena ini bukan soal cuaca. Pilihan C salah karena ia bilang akan baik-baik saja untuk pertandingan. Pilihan D salah karena ia tidak marah.

script.t: The history lecture is in Room 204, isn't it?
No, they switched it to the auditorium. Too many students enrolled.

items.question: Where is the history lecture now?
items.explanation: Pria itu berkata kuliahnya dipindah (switched) ke auditorium karena terlalu banyak mahasiswa yang mendaftar. Pilihan A adalah lokasi lama. Pilihan C dan D tidak disebutkan.

script.t: Should I start studying for the final now or wait until the weekend?
I wouldn't put it off if I were you. There's a ton of material.

items.question: What does the woman suggest?
options: He should wait until the weekend.
He should skip the final exam.
items.explanation: Wanita itu berkata I wouldn't put it off (aku tidak akan menundanya) karena materinya sangat banyak, artinya ia menyarankan pria itu mulai belajar sekarang. Pilihan B justru kebalikan sarannya. Pilihan C dan D tidak disebutkan.

script.t: Did you hear? The cafeteria is giving away free breakfast on Monday.
You don't have to tell me twice!

items.question: What does the man mean?
items.explanation: Ungkapan You don't have to tell me twice berarti langsung setuju dengan antusias tanpa perlu dibujuk, jadi pria itu sangat mau ikut sarapan gratis. Pilihan A salah karena ia percaya. Pilihan C salah karena ia justru tertarik. Pilihan D salah karena ia tidak meminta detail.

script.t: I can't find my notes from yesterday's lecture.
Relax, I took pretty detailed ones. I'll send you a copy tonight.

items.question: What will the woman do?
options: Send her notes to the man.
items.explanation: Wanita itu berjanji I'll send you a copy tonight (akan kukirim salinannya malam ini), jadi ia akan mengirim catatan kuliahnya kepada pria itu. Pilihan B salah karena ia tidak mengulang kuliah. Pilihan C salah karena yang dipinjamkan adalah catatan, bukan laptop. Pilihan D salah karena ia tidak meminta ke dosen.

script.t: Are you coming to the movie tonight?
I wish I could, but I've got to hit the books. Midterms start Monday.

items.question: What does the man mean?
options: He will go to the movie.
items.explanation: Ungkapan hit the books artinya belajar dengan giat. Pria itu tidak bisa ikut nonton karena harus belajar untuk ujian tengah semester. Pilihan A salah karena ia menolak ajakan. Pilihan C salah karena ia tidak kehilangan buku. Pilihan D salah karena ia tidak bekerja di toko buku.

script.t: The bus to downtown leaves every twenty minutes.
Good, we just missed one, so we won't have to wait long.

items.question: What does the woman imply?
options: They should take a taxi instead.
The next bus will come soon.
items.explanation: Bus berangkat tiap dua puluh menit dan mereka baru saja ketinggalan satu, jadi bus berikutnya akan segera datang dan mereka tidak perlu menunggu lama. Pilihan A salah karena ia tidak menyarankan taksi. Pilihan B salah karena tidak dibilang bus selalu telat. Pilihan C salah karena masih ada bus berikutnya.

script.t: Your presentation was amazing. How long did you prepare?
Thanks! Honestly, I threw it together last night.

items.question: What does the man imply about his presentation?
options: He worked on it for weeks.
items.explanation: Ungkapan threw it together artinya mengerjakan sesuatu dengan cepat dan seadanya. Pria itu menyiapkan presentasinya secara kilat semalam. Pilihan B salah karena bukan berminggu-minggu. Pilihan C salah karena ia tidak bilang tidak puas. Pilihan D salah karena ia tidak menyontek.

script.t: Is the tutoring center open on weekends?
Only on Saturdays, from ten to two.

items.question: When is the tutoring center open on weekends?
options: On Saturdays from ten to two.
items.explanation: Wanita itu menjawab jelas: hanya hari Sabtu, pukul sepuluh sampai dua. Pilihan A salah karena tidak sepanjang akhir pekan. Pilihan B salah karena bukan hari Minggu. Pilihan D salah karena Sabtu termasuk akhir pekan.

script.t: This math problem set is due at midnight, and I'm only halfway done.
Want to work on it together at my place? Two heads are better than one.

items.question: What does the man suggest?
options: Asking the professor for an extension.
items.explanation: Pria itu mengajak mengerjakan soal bersama (work on it together) dan menambahkan peribahasa two heads are better than one yang artinya kerja berdua lebih baik. Pilihan A, B, dan C tidak sesuai dengan tawarannya.

script.t: The new economics textbook costs an arm and a leg.
Tell me about it. I had to sell my old books to afford it.

items.question: What does the man mean about the textbook?
items.explanation: Ungkapan costs an arm and a leg artinya harganya sangat mahal. Wanita itu pun setuju sampai harus menjual buku lamanya. Pilihan B salah karena bukan soal berat. Pilihan C salah karena bukan soal sulit dibaca. Pilihan D salah karena bukunya tersedia, hanya mahal.

script.t: Do you know where Professor Chen's office hours are posted?
On her door, I think. Or check the course website.

items.question: Where can the woman find the office hours?
options: On the professor's door or the course website.
items.explanation: Pria itu menyebut dua tempat: di pintu ruangan dosen (on her door) atau di situs web mata kuliah. Pilihan B, C, dan D tidak disebutkan.

script.t: The field trip to the botanical garden is still on for Saturday?
The forecast says heavy rain all weekend, so don't hold your breath.

items.question: What does the woman imply?
options: The trip will probably be canceled.
items.explanation: Ungkapan don't hold your breath artinya jangan terlalu berharap. Karena prakiraan menyebut hujan lebat sepanjang akhir pekan, wanita itu menyiratkan karyawisata kemungkinan besar batal. Pilihan B kebalikan maksudnya. Pilihan C salah karena ia tidak bilang benci. Pilihan D salah karena ia justru mengacu pada prakiraan itu.

script.t: I aced the chemistry quiz!
No way! I barely passed. You must have studied all night.

items.question: What can be inferred about the woman's quiz result?
items.explanation: Kata aced artinya mendapat nilai sempurna atau sangat tinggi. Pria itu kaget dan menduga wanita itu belajar semalaman. Pilihan A salah karena tidak ada indikasi menyontek. Pilihan B salah karena ia justru sukses. Pilihan C salah karena kuisnya sudah dikerjakan.

script.t: My laptop keeps freezing during online lectures.
Have you tried clearing the cache? That usually does the trick.

items.question: What does the woman suggest?
items.explanation: Wanita itu menyarankan membersihkan cache (clearing the cache) dan berkata that usually does the trick yang artinya biasanya berhasil. Pilihan A salah karena ia tidak menyarankan bolos. Pilihan C salah karena tidak disarankan beli laptop baru. Pilihan D salah karena tidak ada saran menelepon dosen.

script.t: Can you believe the concert tickets sold out in ten minutes?
I know. I was stuck in the virtual waiting room the whole time.

items.question: What does the man imply?
items.explanation: Pria itu berkata ia terjebak di ruang tunggu virtual (virtual waiting room) sepanjang waktu, artinya ia tidak berhasil membeli tiket sebelum habis. Pilihan A salah karena ia tidak dapat tiket. Pilihan B salah karena ia tidak menonton. Pilihan D salah karena ia justru ingin menonton.

script.t: I heard the campus gym is closed for renovations.
Great. Just when I finally built a routine.

items.question: What does the woman imply?
options: She is happy about the closure.
She is annoyed by the timing.
items.explanation: Kata Great di sini bernada sarkastis: tepat saat ia akhirnya punya rutinitas olahraga, gym malah tutup. Jadi ia kesal dengan waktunya. Pilihan A salah karena ia tidak senang. Pilihan B salah karena ia justru rutin berolahraga. Pilihan C salah karena ia pengunjung, bukan pegawai.

script.t: Your roommate seems nice. How long have you known him?
Since orientation week. We clicked right away.

items.question: What does the man mean by "clicked"?
items.explanation: Ungkapan clicked dalam konteks pertemanan artinya langsung akrab atau cocok. Pria itu langsung berteman baik dengan teman sekamarnya sejak minggu orientasi. Pilihan A salah karena mereka tidak bertengkar. Pilihan C salah karena mereka bertemu saat orientasi. Pilihan D salah karena tidak dibahas.

script.t: The Wi-Fi in the dorm keeps dropping during my video calls.
Same here. The IT desk said they're installing new routers next week.

items.question: What will happen next week?
options: The Wi-Fi will be shut off.
items.explanation: Wanita itu berkata bagian IT akan memasang router baru minggu depan (installing new routers next week). Pilihan B salah karena Wi-Fi tidak dimatikan. Pilihan C salah karena asrama tidak ditutup. Pilihan D salah karena panggilan video tidak dilarang.

script.t: Are you signing up for the debate club?

items.question: What does the man mean?
items.explanation: Ungkapan on the fence artinya ragu-ragu atau belum memutuskan. Jadwalnya yang padat membuatnya belum bisa memutuskan ikut klub debat. Pilihan A salah karena ia belum gabung. Pilihan B salah karena ia tidak bilang tahun depan. Pilihan D salah karena ia tidak bilang benci debat.

script.t: Did the study group meet yesterday?
We pushed it to Thursday. Half the group had a lab conflict.

items.question: Why was the study group postponed?
options: Several members had a scheduling conflict.
items.explanation: Wanita itu berkata pertemuan diundur (pushed) ke hari Kamis karena separuh anggota bentrok dengan jadwal lab (lab conflict). Pilihan A salah karena tidak ada soal ruangan terkunci. Pilihan B salah karena anggotanya mau belajar. Pilihan C salah karena tidak ada tutor yang batal.

script.t: How do I get to the science building from here?
Go straight past the fountain, then take the second left. You can't miss it.

items.question: What is the man doing?
items.explanation: Pria itu memberi petunjuk arah langkah demi langkah: lurus melewati air mancur lalu belok kiri kedua. Pilihan A salah karena air mancur hanya patokan arah. Pilihan C salah karena ia tidak mengajak ke kelas. Pilihan D salah karena ia tidak mengeluh.

script.t: I pulled an all-nighter finishing my portfolio.
You look exhausted. Maybe grab some coffee before the critique.

items.question: What does the woman suggest?
items.explanation: Wanita itu menyarankan pria itu minum kopi (grab some coffee) sebelum sesi kritik karena ia terlihat kelelahan setelah begadang (pulled an all-nighter). Pilihan A salah karena ia tidak menyarankan bolos. Pilihan B salah karena portofolionya sudah selesai. Pilihan D salah karena ia tidak menyarankan tidur lagi.

script.t: The professor posts the lecture slides before class.
That helps a lot. I can follow along instead of scribbling notes.

items.question: What does the man imply?
items.explanation: Pria itu berkata slide sangat membantu karena ia bisa mengikuti kuliah tanpa harus mencoret-coret catatan dengan terburu-buru (scribbling notes). Pilihan A salah karena ia hadir di kelas. Pilihan B salah karena ia justru suka slide. Pilihan C salah karena buku teks tidak dibahas.

script.t: Is it true the parking permit fees went up again?

items.question: What does the woman think about the fee increase?
items.explanation: Ungkapan highway robbery artinya harga yang sangat tidak wajar, seperti dirampok. Wanita itu menganggap kenaikan biaya parkir tidak adil. Pilihan A salah karena ia tidak menganggapnya wajar. Pilihan B salah karena ia tidak bingung. Pilihan C salah karena ia tidak bilang melanggar hukum.

script.t: Thanks for seeing me, Professor Alvarez. I'm thinking of switching my major to environmental science.
That's a big decision. What made you consider the switch?
Honestly, the biology classes I've taken this year have been the highlight of my schedule.
That's a good sign. Have you looked at the required courses for the major?
A little. I noticed there's a field research component in the junior year.
Right, two weeks at the coastal research station. Most students say it's the best part.
It sounds amazing, but I'm worried about falling behind on credits.
Many of your biology credits will transfer. Why don't we map out a plan together next week?

questions.question: What is the conversation mainly about?
options: The man's plan to change his major.
questions.explanation: Seluruh percakapan membahas rencana pria itu pindah jurusan ke environmental science dan kekhawatirannya soal kredit. Pilihan B salah karena riset lapangan hanya satu detail jurusan itu. Pilihan C salah karena bukan proyek si wanita. Pilihan D salah karena syarat kelulusan tidak dibahas.

questions.question: According to the woman, what is part of the junior year?
questions.explanation: Wanita itu berkata ada dua minggu riset lapangan di stasiun penelitian pesisir (two weeks at the coastal research station) pada tahun ketiga. Pilihan A, C, dan D tidak disebutkan.

questions.question: What does the man worry about?
questions.explanation: Pria itu berkata I'm worried about falling behind on credits, artinya ia khawatir tertinggal atau kehilangan kredit akademik jika pindah jurusan. Pilihan A salah karena biaya kuliah tidak dibahas. Pilihan B salah karena tempat tinggal tidak dibahas. Pilihan D salah karena ia justru menikmati kelas biologi.

questions.explanation: Wanita itu mengusulkan Why don't we map out a plan together next week, yaitu menyusun rencana mata kuliah bersama minggu depan. Pilihan A salah karena ia tidak menyarankan berhenti. Pilihan B dan C tidak diusulkan.

My cousin is moving out of her place next month. It's a two-bedroom, and the rent is pretty reasonable.

About a fifteen-minute walk. And there's a bus stop right outside.
That sounds perfect. When can I take a look at it?
She's free this Saturday afternoon. I could go with you if you want.
That would be great. Thanks for thinking of me.

questions.question: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
questions.explanation: Percakapan berfokus pada pencarian apartemen untuk pria itu, termasuk anggaran, lokasi, dan jadwal melihat unit sepupu si wanita. Pilihan A salah karena halte bus hanya detail lokasi. Pilihan C dan D tidak dibahas.

questions.question: What is the man's budget?
questions.explanation: Pria itu berkata I'm looking for something under six hundred a month, jadi anggarannya di bawah 600 dolar per bulan. Pilihan B dan C angkanya tidak tepat. Pilihan D salah karena ia menyebut batas anggarannya.

questions.explanation: Apartemen itu sewanya wajar (reasonable), hanya lima belas menit jalan kaki dari kampus, dan ada halte bus di depan, sehingga cocok dengan kebutuhan dan anggaran pria itu. Pilihan A salah karena lokasinya dekat. Pilihan B salah karena sepupu itu baru akan pindah bulan depan. Pilihan C salah karena sewanya terjangkau.

questions.explanation: Wanita itu berkata sepupunya bisa ditemui hari Sabtu sore dan ia bisa menemani pria itu, jadi mereka kemungkinan akan melihat apartemennya. Pilihan A salah karena belum sampai tanda tangan kontrak. Pilihan B salah karena tujuannya melihat apartemen, bukan makan siang. Pilihan D tidak dibahas.

script.t: Today I want to talk about how plants survive in the desert, one of the harshest environments on Earth. With very little rainfall and extreme heat, you might expect nothing to grow there, but desert plants have developed remarkable adaptations. The cactus, for example, stores water in its thick, fleshy stem, and its leaves have evolved into spines. These spines reduce water loss and also protect the plant from animals looking for moisture. Other plants, like the creosote bush, have tiny, waxy leaves that limit evaporation. Some desert plants take a completely different approach: they avoid the dry season altogether. Annual wildflowers survive as seeds buried in the soil, sometimes for years, and they only sprout after rare heavy rains. Within days, the desert floor can be covered in color. So while the desert looks empty, it is actually full of clever survival strategies. Scientists study these adaptations not only out of curiosity, but also to develop crops that can survive in drier climates.

questions.question: What is the talk mainly about?
options: How desert plants adapt to dry conditions.
questions.explanation: Ceramah membahas berbagai adaptasi tumbuhan gurun untuk bertahan di lingkungan kering dan panas. Pilihan B salah karena sejarah eksplorasi tidak dibahas. Pilihan C salah karena perluasan gurun tidak dibahas. Pilihan D salah karena cara menanam kaktus di dalam ruangan tidak dibahas.

questions.question: According to the speaker, what is one function of cactus spines?
questions.explanation: Pembicara berkata duri kaktus reduce water loss (mengurangi kehilangan air) dan melindungi dari hewan. Pilihan A salah karena duri tidak menyerap air hujan. Pilihan B salah karena tidak menarik penyerbuk. Pilihan D salah karena yang menyimpan air adalah batangnya, bukan durinya.

questions.question: How do annual wildflowers survive drought?
options: By remaining as seeds until it rains.
By storing water in their stems.
questions.explanation: Pembicara berkata bunga liar tahunan survive as seeds buried in the soil dan baru bertunas setelah hujan lebat yang jarang terjadi. Pilihan A salah karena akar dalam tidak disebutkan. Pilihan C salah karena itu cara kaktus. Pilihan D salah karena tumbuhan tidak berpindah tempat.

questions.question: What does the speaker imply about deserts?
options: They receive no rainfall at all.
They are full of survival strategies.
questions.explanation: Kalimat penutup berkata gurun sebenarnya full of clever survival strategies, jadi gurun penuh strategi bertahan hidup yang cerdik. Pilihan A, B, dan C bertentangan dengan isi ceramah yang menunjukkan gurun penuh kehidupan.

script.t: In the 1440s, a German inventor named Johannes Gutenberg developed a printing press with movable metal type, and it changed the world. Before his invention, books had to be copied by hand, a slow process that made books extremely expensive. Only the wealthy, churches, and universities could afford them. Gutenberg's press could produce hundreds of pages per day, which brought the price of books down dramatically. Ideas could now spread faster than ever before. Scientists shared their discoveries, religious reformers spread their arguments, and news traveled across Europe in printed pamphlets. Some historians argue that the printing press did for knowledge what the internet would later do: it made information available to ordinary people. Of course, the press also spread misinformation, just as new media does today. Still, most scholars agree that without Gutenberg's invention, the rapid advances of the Renaissance and the Scientific Revolution might never have happened. His most famous product, the Gutenberg Bible, remains one of the most valuable books in the world.

questions.question: What is the talk mainly about?
options: The impact of the printing press.
questions.explanation: Ceramah membahas dampak mesin cetak Gutenberg terhadap penyebaran pengetahuan dan kemajuan zaman. Pilihan A salah karena riwayat hidup Gutenberg tidak dibahas detail. Pilihan B salah karena teknik cetak modern tidak dibahas. Pilihan D salah karena fokusnya bukan penemuan Jerman secara umum.

questions.question: Before the printing press, why were books expensive?
questions.explanation: Pembicara berkata books had to be copied by hand, a slow process that made books extremely expensive. Pilihan B salah karena kelangkaan kertas tidak disebutkan. Pilihan C salah karena belum ada percetakan. Pilihan D salah karena gereja hanya disebut sebagai pembeli, bukan pengendali harga.

questions.question: The speaker compares the printing press to the internet because both...
questions.explanation: Pembicara berkata mesin cetak did for knowledge what the internet would later do: it made information available to ordinary people. Pilihan A salah karena internet tidak ditemukan di Jerman. Pilihan B salah karena tidak dibilang menggantikan total. Pilihan C salah karena justru untuk orang biasa.

questions.question: According to the speaker, what might not have happened without the printing press?
options: The advances of the Renaissance and Scientific Revolution.
questions.explanation: Pembicara berkata tanpa penemuan Gutenberg, the rapid advances of the Renaissance and the Scientific Revolution might never have happened. Pilihan A salah karena kertas sudah ada sebelumnya. Pilihan C salah karena misinformasi justru ikut tersebar. Pilihan D salah karena Alkitab sudah ditulis jauh sebelumnya.

script.t: Impressionism was a radical art movement that began in France in the 1870s. Before it appeared, most respected painters worked indoors in studios, creating detailed, carefully finished scenes from history or mythology. The Impressionists broke these rules. Artists like Claude Monet and Pierre-Auguste Renoir took their easels outside and painted quickly, trying to capture the changing light of a single moment. Instead of mixing colors smoothly on a palette, they placed small dabs of pure color side by side on the canvas, letting the viewer's eye blend them together. At first, critics laughed at the unfinished look. In fact, the name Impressionism came from a mocking review of Monet's painting Impression, Sunrise. But the public eventually embraced the fresh, lively style. Today, Impressionist paintings are among the most beloved in the world, and the movement opened the door to modern art by proving that a painting did not have to look like a photograph to be powerful.

questions.question: What is the talk mainly about?
questions.explanation: Ceramah membahas gerakan seni Impresionisme: awal mulanya, tekniknya, dan pengaruhnya. Pilihan A salah karena museum tidak dibahas. Pilihan B salah karena riwayat hidup Monet tidak dibahas. Pilihan D salah karena fotografi hanya disebut sebagai pembanding.

questions.question: How did the Impressionists paint differently?
options: They used only black and white.
